column1: # HELD-OUT: Codex 534 f. 15r, letter dated "Di Firenze 20 Nov. 1690", signed "Il Gran Duca di Toscana". Interlinear letters in a lighter ink (recipient). Read 13 Nov 2026 after key_v1 was frozen.
